messages:
Nina: quick postmortem follow-up 305 focusing on reducing paging noise. we need owners for: dedupe rules, threshold tuning, and paging cadence.
Omar: I can take dedupe. plan: add grouping by service+region, set group_interval=8m, repeat_interval=20m. will prototype with a single noisy service.
Priya: I'll take thresholds. action: compute 21-day baseline per-env, set two tiers (warning, page) and require 2 consecutive evaluations before paging. will deliver numbers by Mon.
ops-bot: created ONCALL-10021 (dedupe) assigned Omar; ONCALL-10022 (thresholds) assigned Priya.
Nina: paging cadence: want to shorten first escalation for critical services to 5m but increase suppression to avoid duplicates during warmups. who can update runbook?
Omar: I'll update the runbook with dedupe play and examples of warmup spikes to ignore. also will add a test that simulates instance churn.
Priya: will add a metric label "scale_reason" so alerts triggered during autoscale can be classified as warning-only for 3m. also propose a dashboard: unique_alerts vs total_alerts.
pd-bot: applied temporary 2h silence to kv-cache-5xx for validation window.
Nina: timelines: Omar due 2026-04-09, Priya due 2026-04-16. weekly check-ins Tue 10:00 PT. I'll add owners to the postmortem follow-up table. keep updates in the tickets. thanks :thumbsup:
